attributes.body:
Fischer Medical Ventures highlights strategic partnership as NYB.AI showcased at NVIDIA GTC Taiwan 2026.

Mumbai, India: Fischer Medical Ventures Limited (FMVL) today announced that its strategic partner, Nanyang Biologics, has achieved a significant international milestone with its AI-powered molecular research platform, NYB.AI, being featured in the opening showcase at

Mumbai, India: Fischer Medical Ventures Limited (FMVL) today announced that its strategic partner, Nanyang Biologics, has achieved a significant international milestone with its AI-powered molecular research platform, NYB.AI, being featured in the opening showcase at NVIDIA GTC Taiwan 2026, ahead of the keynote address by NVIDIA Founder and CEO Jensen Huang. The recognition places NYB.AI among a select group of innovators from NVIDIA's global Inception ecosystem driving advancements in artificial intelligence, computational biology and next-generation scientific research.

For Fischer Medical Ventures, the recognition reinforces the strength of its strategic partnership with Nanyang Biologics and aligns with the Company's vision of bringing world-class AI-enabled molecular research capabilities to India, supporting the country's growing pharmaceutical innovation ecosystem.

Advancing India's Pharmaceutical Innovation Journey

India has earned global recognition as one of the world's leading pharmaceutical manufacturing hubs, and Fischer Medical Ventures believes the next phase of growth lies in advancing AI-driven drug discovery and molecular research. Through its strategic partnership with Nanyang Biologics, the Company aims to introduce advanced molecular research technologies to India, foster collaboration with pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology innovators, academic institutions and research organisations, and accelerate the discovery of novel therapeutic molecules. By combining artificial intelligence with India's scientific expertise and rich botanical and Ayurvedic heritage, the partnership seeks to support evidence-based therapeutic innovation, subject to scientific validation and regulatory approvals.

Exclusive India Partnership

Fischer Medical Ventures serves as the exclusive distributor in India for selected NYB technologies and scientifically developed plant-based nutraceutical products, subject to applicable regulatory approvals. The initial phase of the partnership focuses on introducing plant-based nutraceutical formulations designed to support cardiovascular health, liver health and overall wellness, while supporting future collaborations with universities, pharmaceutical companies and research institutions to advance AI-enabled life sciences research in India.

Leadership Commentary

Mr. Ravindran Govindan, Chairman, Fischer Medical Ventures Limited, said:

"NYB.AI's recognition at NVIDIA GTC Taiwan 2026 validates the strength of the technology developed by our strategic partner, Nanyang Biologics. We are proud to work alongside an organisation that is helping redefine AI-driven molecular research, and we look forward to introducing these capabilities to India's scientific and pharmaceutical community."

"India possesses exceptional scientific talent, a globally respected pharmaceutical industry and a rich heritage of botanical knowledge. By combining these strengths with advanced artificial intelligence, we have an opportunity to accelerate innovation, strengthen research capabilities and contribute to the discovery of new therapies that address unmet medical needs."

Ms. Svetlana Rao Raviwada, Whole-Time Executive Director, Fischer Medical Ventures Limited, said:

"Our partnership with Nanyang Biologics is about more than bringing advanced technology to India; it is about building an AI-enabled life sciences ecosystem that strengthens collaboration between academia, research institutions and the pharmaceutical industry. Through advanced platforms such as Vecura, we aim to equip Indian researchers with world-class AI-powered molecular research capabilities that can accelerate scientific discovery and foster innovation across the healthcare and life sciences sectors."

Introducing Vecura

At the centre of Nanyang Biologics' AI ecosystem is Vecura, an advanced molecular research platform that leverages state-of-the-art atomistic artificial intelligence models, including Meta FAIR's Universal Models for Atoms (UMA). Through a secure, no-code environment, Vecura enables researchers to simulate molecular behaviour, predict material properties and conduct high-throughput computational analysis, with the potential to accelerate therapeutic discovery, improve research efficiency and reduce the computational complexity traditionally associated with molecular modelling.

Long-Term Vision

Fischer Medical Ventures and Nanyang Biologics share a long-term vision of strengthening India's capabilities in AI-driven pharmaceutical research. Through collaboration with academia, industry and research institutions, the partnership aims to accelerate scientific innovation and support India's emergence as a global hub for innovation-driven healthcare and next-generation therapeutic discovery, subject to scientific validation and regulatory approvals.

NYB.AI launches Vecura 2.0 to facilitate agentic AI in molecular discovery

* 2026.06.03
* 10:34
* Commercial Times, Guo Jingzhi

As agentic AI becomes a new industry focus, the life sciences sector is also exploring autonomous R&D models. Singapore-based AI startup NYB.AI is dedicated to developing infrastructure for molecular discovery and life science research. To address this pain point, the company launched the agentic AI platform Vecura, integrating scientific models, biological data, molecular analysis tools, and GPU-accelerated computing into a single discovery workflow.

Vecura 2.0 builds on the foundation of Vecura 1.0, which provided AI models and scientific tools for molecular exploration. The 2.0 version adds an agentic architecture layer, evolving from 'tool invocation' to 'automated workflow execution.' It helps R&D teams define scientific goals, retrieve contextual data, activate the most suitable models, compare output results, and automatically generate structured decision-support reports with reduced manual coordination.

From model invocation to agentic workflows

The original inspiration for Vecura stems from a simple concept: the next bottleneck for AI in science is no longer about accessing more models, but rather how to make these models work efficiently together in real-world R&D scenarios. Vecura 1.0 already connected hundreds of AI models, scientific tools, biological data, and molecular analysis functions into a unified workflow, enabling R&D teams to perform compound analysis, target discovery, formulation research, toxicity assessment, and translational medicine without switching between isolated systems.

The new Vecura 2.0 introduces an agentic AI architecture layer with reasoning capabilities across the entire workflow. It can deeply understand research objectives, retrieve scientific literature context, select optimal models, coordinate processes, compare results, and automatically generate structured next-step decision recommendations. This transforms Vecura from a workflow platform into a more intelligent exploration system, assisting scientists at scale and more closely resembling real research decision-making processes.

This AI agent operational model allows scientists to focus on research directions rather than complex infrastructure management, further realizing NYB.AI's vision of democratizing molecular discovery - lowering the barrier to using cutting-edge AI models, scientific tools, and GPU-intensive workflows, enabling R&D teams beyond large pharmaceutical companies and specialized computational laboratories to access these advanced technologies.

Advancing scalable access with NVIDIA technology

NYB.AI is leveraging NVIDIA technology to comprehensively enhance Vecura's agentic AI architecture for scientific discovery. As a member of the NVIDIA Inception startup program, NYB.AI has gained access to NVIDIA Hopper GPU computing resources and engineering guidance through NVIDIA's Innovation Lab, improving Vecura's ability to plan, execute, and coordinate complex research tasks. This support allows Vecura to move beyond isolated model execution toward efficiently chained workflows, integrating scientific context, model selection, inference, comparison, and decision support within a single system.

Vecura is entirely powered by NVIDIA technologies, spanning agent orchestration, scientific modeling, data and retrieval, and production deployment, all running on the NVIDIA accelerated computing platform.

Additionally, NYB.AI is developing a token-based credit access model for Vecura 2.0. Through platform credits, biotech and pharmaceutical companies, ingredient suppliers, and research teams can easily access AI-driven discovery workflows, such as compound screening, bioactivity prediction, and molecular docking. This model allows users to run compute-intensive scientific tasks directly on the NYB.AI platform without needing to build or operate underlying infrastructure.

Future outlook

NYB.AI will bring Vecura 2.0 to the InnoVEX 2026 (June 2-5, 2026, at Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center) Inception Pavilion, participating in the NVIDIA Inception startup showcase. This exhibition provides an opportunity to validate Vecura 2.0 with corporate leaders, investors, ecosystem partners, and international buyers, strengthening its visibility within the NVIDIA Inception ecosystem - demonstrating how agentic AI can move beyond pure model experimentation into truly practical R&D infrastructure for molecular discovery teams.

At InnoVEX 2026, NYB.AI will demonstrate how Vecura 2.0 fully supports molecular discovery and life science research, spanning applications in pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, cosmetics, food science, functional ingredients, and public health. Vecura 2.0 embodies NYB.AI's long-term mission: to make advanced AI exploration infrastructure more practical, scalable, and accessible within the life sciences ecosystem.

attributes.body:
NYB.AI launches Vecura 2.0, bringing agentic AI workflows to molecular discovery, with NVIDIA.

Tuesday, June 02, 2026

Life science research is entering an AI era, but most discovery teams still cannot use frontier models at scale. Advanced AI models, molecular simulation tools, scientific databases, inference optimization and GPU infrastructure remain fragmented across separate systems. For many pharmaceutical companies, ingredient innovators, biotech teams, and research groups, this makes AI adoption slow, costly, and technically demanding.

NYB.AI, a Singapore Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology startup developing infrastructure for molecular discovery and life science research, aims to address this gap with Vecura, its agentic AI platform that connects scientific models, biological data, molecular analysis tools, and GPU accelerated computing into a unified discovery workflow.

Vecura 2.0 builds on the original Vecura 1.0 platform, which provided access to AI models and scientific tools for molecular discovery. With the new agentic layer, Vecura 2.0 moves beyond tool access toward workflow execution. It is designed to help research teams define scientific objectives, retrieve relevant context, activate suitable models, compare outputs, and generate structured decision support with less manual coordination.

From model access to agentic workflows

Vecura was built around a simple premise: the next barrier in AI for science is not access to more models. It is the ability to make those models work together in discovery settings. The original Vecura platform brought hundreds of AI models, scientific tools, biological data, and molecular analysis capabilities into connected workflows, helping research teams move across compound analysis, target exploration, formulation research, toxicity assessment, and translational R&D without relying on separate systems at every step.

Vecura 2.0 extends this foundation with an agentic AI layer. The upgraded platform is designed to reason across the workflow by understanding research objectives, retrieving relevant scientific context, selecting suitable models, coordinating execution, comparing outputs, and generating structured next step recommendations. This evolves Vecura from a workflow platform into a more intelligent discovery system that can assist scientists at scale, closer to how real research decisions are made.

This agentic approach allows scientists to focus on research direction rather than infrastructure management. It also supports NYB.AI's broader vision to democratize molecular discovery by making advanced AI models, scientific tools, and GPU intensive workflows more accessible to teams beyond large pharmaceutical organizations and specialized computational labs.

Scaling access through NVIDIA technologies

NYB.AI is strengthening Vecura's agentic architecture for scientific discovery using NVIDIA technologies. As a member of the NVIDIA Inception program for startups, NYB.AI received access to NVIDIA Hopper GPUs through NVIDIA Innovation Lab, along with engineering guidance to advance Vecura's ability to plan, execute, and coordinate complex research tasks. This support enables Vecura to move beyond isolated model execution toward connected workflows where scientific context, model selection, inference, comparison, and decision support operate as one system.

Vecura is powered by NVIDIA technologies spanning agentic orchestration, scientific modeling, data and retrieval, and production deployment - all running on NVIDIA accelerated computing.

NYB.AI is also developing a token based access model for Vecura 2.0. Through platform credits, biopharma companies, ingredient companies, and research teams can access AI powered discovery workflows such as compound screening, bioactivity prediction, and molecular docking. This model allows users to run compute intensive scientific tasks through NYB.AI's platform without needing to build or operate their own infrastructure.

What's next?

NYB.AI is bringing Vecura 2.0 to the NVIDIA Inception Startup Showcase at the Inception Pavilion during InnoVEX 2026 (June 2-5, 2026, Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center). The showcase will give NYB.AI an opportunity to validate Vecura 2.0 with enterprise leaders, investors, ecosystem partners, and international buyers, and strengthens its visibility within NVIDIA Inception ecosystem - demonstrating how agentic AI can move beyond model experimentation into usable research infrastructure for molecular discovery teams.

At InnoVEX 2026, NYB.AI will demonstrate how Vecura 2.0 can support molecular discovery and life science research across pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, cosmetics, food science, functional ingredients, and consumer health. The platform reflects NYB.AI's broader mission to make advanced AI discovery infrastructure more usable, scalable, and accessible across the life science ecosystem.

About NYB.AI

NYB.AI is an AI biotechnology company developing infrastructure for molecular discovery and life science research. Its flagship platform, Vecura, is an agentic AI platform that connects AI models, scientific tools, biological data, retrieval systems, accelerated computing, and autonomous workflows to help life science teams shorten discovery cycles and prioritize high-potential candidates.
